(2) The man stands alone in the room, looking around guiltily while chewing the banana, with a white cabinet and mirror visible in the background. (3) He walks towards a glass sliding door and opens it, revealing a rainy outdoor patio area with a basketball hoop and a wet ground surface. (4) Outside, he stands under a small roof overhang, looking at the woman who is crouching in the rain near the basketball pole wearing the same white cardigan. (5) The woman stands up and walks slowly towards the camera in the rain, her expression neutral as she approaches the sliding door where the man is standing. (6) As she reaches him, she suddenly pushes him out into the rain with both hands; he stumbles backward onto the wet concrete. (7) She quickly pulls the sliding door shut and turns a locking mechanism while the man stands outside, soaked, tapping on the glass and continuing to eat his banana while looking through the window.
